fullPassage: Even outdoors, although climate (including temperature) is usually regarded as beyond the control of man, localized temperature control is sometimes effective on a microclimate scale. Vancouver, Canada, is a few miles north of the 49th parallel, about 60 miles farther north than Minot, North Dakota, with its legendary harsh winter temperatures. But constant foehn winds off the Pacific Ocean make Vancouver winters mild and wet, although sunshine is scant. When I had a garden there in the late 1940s, a neighbor used to say that I "cheated God" to bring in my lettuce and tomatoes earlier than anyone else. The bed in which the vegetables grew was banked toward the south at approximately 50 degrees, and the area between the plants was covered with flat stones, gathered from the nearby beach, to maximize soil heating from the weak late winter–early spring sun.

When I had a garden there in the late 1940s, a neighbor used to say that I "cheated God" to bring in my lettuce and tomatoes earlier than anyone else. The bed in which the vegetables grew was banked toward the south at approximately 50 degrees, and the area between the plants was covered with flat stones, gathered from the nearby beach, to maximize soil heating from the weak late winter–early spring sun.

det.korean: 기후는 '인간의 통제를 벗어나는(beyond the control of man)' 것으로 간주된다.

③ subject to human intervention(인간 개입의 대상인): 대조 관계 성립 안 됨 ❌

det.korean: 납작한 돌을 깐 목적은 '토양 가열을 극대화(to maximize soil heating)'하기 위해서.
det.analysis:
① to prevent weed growth(잡초 성장을 막기 위해): 돌의 역할은 태양열 흡수이지 잡초 방지가 아님 ❌
② to cool the ground surface(지표면을 식히기 위해): 가열이 목적이므로 반대 ❌
③ to maximize soil heating(토양 가열을 극대화하기 위해): 약한 늦겨울 햇볕의 열을 최대한 흡수하려는 목적 ✅ ←정답
④ to decorate the garden bed(텃밭을 장식하기 위해): 미적 목적이 아닌 실용적 목적 ❌
det.tip: to maximize soil heating — 납작한 돌이 태양열을 흡수해 토양을 데움
